about: CAP5 (capture round 5): every capture the round-5 runbook (docs/pine/capture-round-5-runbook.md) can grade with the harness. Rows are keyed by idPrefix; cap5Captures.measure.test.js (CAP5_MEASURE=1) resolves each to the NEWEST tests/fixtures/vendor/harness/<idPrefix>-<yyyy-mm-dd>.json, writes `id`, and rewrites `signature` from the harness's own verdict through cap3Signature. Never edit a signature by hand. A row whose capture is absent keeps id null and signature null. Vendor-packet items (M1-M10) and the theme captures are read, not graded, and are not listed here.
